allowed_implementation_freedom: Internal language types, module boundaries, algorithms, and storage are unconstrained when every cited observable distinction is preserved.
Exact diagnostic wording and ordering are unconstrained unless a cited authority explicitly requires them.
canonical_input_forms: structured metadata plus Draft 2020-12 base and overlay schemas
non_normative_behaviors: Python object types, exception classes, module layout, and incidental algorithms are not semantic authority.
Rust crate, module, and internal type layout are not semantic authority.
required_state_distinctions: base and overlay Draft 2020-12 schemas independently validate metadata
format checking rejects an impossible calendar date
the generic mapping requirement accepts only mappings
the generic string requirement accepts only nonempty strings
the generic string-list requirement rejects duplicates and empty values
self-reference and missing relation targets are reported structurally
relation vocabulary remains consumer-owned and is not interpreted
